description:
MCP Agent Trajectory Benchmark
	

A benchmark dataset of 38 MCP (Model Context Protocol) agents with complete tool-use trajectories in the ATIF v1.2 (Agent Trajectory Interchange Format) format. Each agent operates in a distinct business domain with custom tools, realistic user conversations, and full execution traces.
Designed for training and evaluating tool-use / function-calling capabilities of LLMs.
